Please read before you send

What happens when Twig Hub receives your order: once you tap Send below, your request goes straight to Twig Hub. Here’s how it works from there:

  • No payment is taken when you submit a request.
  • When your stick is confirmed for an upcoming bulk order, we’ll send you an itemized invoice and estimated timeline.
  • Payment is due before we place the supplier order.
  • We’ll confirm your stick specifications and pickup or shipping details in writing.
  • Stick orders roughly take 2.5 weeks for build and shipping once the bulk order is placed. We also have to have enough sticks gathered to place an order, so that could delay it even further.
  • If the bulk order is delayed or doesn’t proceed by the stated date, you can choose a refund or to wait for the next order.

Good To Know

Quick answers.

Are these official Bauer or CCM sticks?

No. They are unbranded Twig Hub supplier builds. Brand names identify the specification reference only; materials and construction may differ.

How much do sticks cost?

Player sticks are $264 CAD, the Bauer ADV One pre-order is $267 CAD, and goalie sticks are $317 CAD. These prices include the stick, inbound shipping and duty. Customer delivery shipping is extra and confirmed before payment.

Do I pay when I submit the order form?

No — no payment is taken when you submit a request. When your stick is confirmed for an upcoming bulk order, we’ll send you an itemized invoice and estimated timeline. Payment is due before we place the supplier order.

When will my stick arrive?

Stick orders roughly take 2.5 weeks for build and shipping once the bulk order is placed. Requests are grouped — we have to have enough sticks to place an order, so that could delay it even further. We’ll share an estimated timeline with your invoice, and confirm your specs and pickup or shipping details in writing.

What if the bulk order is delayed or doesn’t go ahead?

If the bulk order is delayed or doesn’t proceed by the stated date, you can choose a refund or to wait for the next order.

Can I pick up in Winnipeg or have it shipped?

Yes — Winnipeg pickup and shipping are both available. Shipping is estimated for your destination and packed parcel, then confirmed before payment.

How do I place an order or ask a question?

Use the order form above — it sends your request straight to Twig Hub, and you can add any question in the notes field.

Prices are CAD and include the stick, inbound supplier shipping and duty; final options and availability are confirmed before payment. Product weights and features describe named retail reference models and do not guarantee identical supplier build specifications.
